notes.title: PAIN 1.08
notes.content:
-Added a way to teleport around for speedrunners, using ctrl-t. Requires beating the game twice before using. I plan to make this better later on but wanted a quick solution for now. 
-Updated speedrun timer to run while paused
-Bugfixes

notes.title: PAIN 1.07
notes.content:
-Added a new special hat!
-bugfixes, visual touch ups, slope updates to match visuals

notes.title: PAIN 1.06
notes.content:
-new speech lines for a few characters (Michael included)
-getting the speed circles will now always grant a double jump
-pickup SFX for collectibles
-Fixed character dialogues resetting once completed and the game restarts
-bug fixes

notes.title: PAIN 1.05

notes.title: PAIN 1.04
notes.content:
Today I bring you a small quality of life patch:

-Reskinned a cosmetic 
-Added gold split display when speedrunning (only after having completed the game at least once)
-Added a shadow to speedrun splits so they are more visible on certain backgrounds
-Fixed some surfaces to prevent the player getting stuck
